On-Chain Operator. Lesson 10.6, Restaking and points: pricing speculative yield. Navy and cyan. One idea at a time. You write it down. Education only.
You already split base yield from emissions. Advanced yield still starts with that split, then names a more particular engine.
Restaking reuses staked assets to secure more services, paying extra rewards and often points: an off-chain score that may or may not become a token.
The risk stack grows at each layer: staking → liquid restaking token → restaking protocol → each service it secures → slashing conditions.
Base the decision on yield you can measure.
Treat points as an airdrop bet: EV = P(payout) × value − costs.
Hedge price if you only want the yield: short the underlying perp (strategy #24), knowing the hedge doesn't cover a depeg of the restaking token.
Cap it: speculative bucket only (≤ 5–10% of DeFi capital).

Check yourself. 1. Why value points at zero? The answer: They're not certain to become anything, so a decision that needs them is a speculation.
Check yourself. 2. What does a perp hedge on the underlying miss? The answer: The restaking token depegging from the underlying.

Check yourself. 3. Name three layers of the restaking risk stack. The answer: Any three: staking/validators, the liquid restaking token, the restaking protocol, each service secured, slashing conditions.
